query: Across role, grade level, and subject, which open-response themes are associated with satisfaction?

per_column.name: theme_tech_issues
per_column.rationale: A genuine thematic axis for the query. But ED-0001 (camera freezes, whiteboard won't load) is a clear tech-issue that was coded 0, revealing miss-classification, though other rows (ED-0003) are correctly grounded.

per_column.name: theme_engagement
per_column.rationale: Strong analytical axis. Codings in ED-0002/0004 are well-supported by the source text; consistent and warranted.

per_column.name: theme_disengagement
per_column.rationale: Useful contrast axis to engagement. ED-0005 (cameras off, silent chat) correctly coded 1; sound reading.

per_column.name: theme_hands_on_need
per_column.rationale: Potentially useful theme, but grounding is weak: ED-0001 coded 1 with no hands-on content in the text (invented), while ED-0002's kitchen-chemistry hands-on content was coded 0. Inconsistent and partly unsupported.

per_column.name: theme_teacher_quality
per_column.rationale: Reasonable axis for the query, but ED-0002 coded 1 from a teacher's self-description of creativity is a shaky inference of 'teacher quality'; borderline over-reading.

per_column.name: theme_equity_concern
per_column.rationale: A relevant distinct theme; rare (11/250) but not near-constant to the point of uselessness. No sampled contradictions, though no positive sample to fully verify.

per_column.name: theme_flexible_learning
per_column.rationale: Meaningful axis. ED-0004 (pause/take notes at own pace) correctly coded 1; well grounded.

per_column.name: theme_social_connection
per_column.rationale: Strong axis for satisfaction analysis. ED-0001 ('miss raising hand') and ED-0003 ('zero peer interaction') coded 1 are defensible readings.

per_column.name: theme_new_opportunity
per_column.rationale: A plausible distinct theme; rare but adds an axis. No sampled evidence contradicts it, though verification is limited.

per_column.name: theme_outcomes_positive
per_column.rationale: Directly relevant to linking themes with satisfaction. No contradictions in samples.

per_column.name: theme_outcomes_negative
per_column.rationale: Relevant outcome axis. ED-0003 (child cries, parents redo worksheets) coded 1 is well supported.

per_column.name: open_response_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Near-constant (227/250 neutral) and largely redundant with satisfaction_1to5. Grounding is poor: ED-0001 (clearly negative) and ED-0004 ('I actually love') both mislabeled 'neutral', contradicting the text.

judge.rationale: The theme flags collectively give strong, distinct analytical axes for relating open-response content to satisfaction across role/grade/subject, which is exactly what the query needs. Groundedness is generally sound (ED-0003, ED-0004, ED-0005 well coded) but uneven: theme_hands_on_need shows an invented positive and a missed positive, theme_tech_issues misses an obvious tech complaint, and theme_teacher_quality over-reads. The sentiment column is the weakest, being near-constant, redundant with the existing satisfaction score, and demonstrably mislabeling clearly positive/negative rows as neutral. Overall the added set is useful with moderate, mixed grounding.
